title: Ugramm
desc: Agastya, an automobile mechanic with a dangerous past, takes it upon himself to protect Nithya, a kidnapped girl, from the vengeful son of a ruthless gangster.

title: Ninne Preethisuve
desc: A soldier dies in a war after he gets engaged to Meghamala. When she learns that his eyes were donated to another man, a sudden turn of events changes her life forever.

title: Ganeshana Galate
desc: Burdened by his wife's endless demands, Ganesh's despair leads him to attempt suicide. Unbeknownst to him, a bounty hunter is on the prowl for him.

title: Chalaki
desc: Due to the demands of their students, a male student is admitted at an all-girls college. But new student Aditya, who dislikes studies, hopes that like in the past, this time too he will be suspended.

title: Gandana Mane
desc: Gauri, a woman from a rich family, falls in love with Raja, a man who makes ends meet as a bus conductor.
